headline: Shreeji Shipping Global Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Shreeji Shipping Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Proposed offer for sale of equity shares of a face value of ₹ 10 each (the  Equity Shares ) of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited (the  Company ), by its…
detail: Updates - Shreeji Shipping Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Proposed offer for sale of equity shares of a face value of ₹ 10 each (the  Equity Shares ) of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited (the  Company ), by its Promoters namely Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Jitendra Haridas Lal, through the stock exchange mechanism in accordance with the relevant circulars issued by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (the  SEBI ) in this regard'.
